entities.name: Niambi Akosa
entities.description: Middle-aged Speaker of Femeref, healer and cleric, daughter of Teferi and Subira.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Former province of Zhalfir where Niambi grew up.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian who invaded Dominaria in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Magistrate Teshunda
entities.description: Magistrate of Femeref persuaded by Niambi.

entities.name: Lark Ojanen
entities.description: Child whose birth Niambi used to influence Teshunda.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event about a decade before Niambi's birth.

events.summary: Niambi helped Teferi solve the puzzles Urza left behind.
events.quote: she helped Teferi solve the many puzzles that the planeswalker Urza had left behind

events.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion Niambi aided Jamuraan nomads and persuaded Magistrate Teshunda to grant refuge to Efravan refugees.
events.quote: to convince Magistrate Teshunda of Femeref to grant refuge to the Efravan refugees

relations.quote: Niambi is the daughter of Teferi and Subira
